items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: I’m very happy to have my personal friend and veteran musician Jack Palmer

ctx.x: Jack was interviewed at Hamilton College on September 24, 1997 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive. Jack’s son, drummer Jack Palmer Jr., was also present during the interview.

My name is Monk Rowe and we’re filming today at Hamilton College for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m very happy to have my personal friend and veteran musician Jack Palmer from Rome, New York. Welcome to Hamilton.
Oh, thank you very much for the nice introduction.
